summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the US analogue of an 8-K furnishing) on 2026-11-05 for the November 2026 period, transmitting Exhibit 99.1, its Risk and Capital Management – Pillar 3 disclosure for the third quarter of 2026. The document is an ordinary Basel-style prudential reporting package covering key metrics, RWA, capital composition, leverage and liquidity ratios, credit and counterparty risk. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake, or regulatory clock is stated. What to watch: purely routine periodic disclosure; no deal or risk-arb angle.
